app.description: The app id, the domain folder name.

title.description: The app name people see, e.g. eTMF. Default the domain name.

version.description: The template version; publishing a template update makes the next one. Default 1.

nouns.description: What a project is called in this app, e.g. { one: study, many: studies }.

home.description: The app home, a page across its projects: { title: TMF across studies, link: All studies }.

templates.description: The template cards shown in New project, by id.

description.description: The line under the title, e.g. "Many sites, visits".

without.description: Template paths a project made from this card leaves out: workflows/<id>, pages/<id>, views/<id>.

title: MemWise app
description: domains/<id>/app.yaml: the domain as a template for projects.
